name: Brussels Sprouts, Grape & Apple Salad with Walnuts & Parmesan
instructions: In a large salad bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper.
Wash brussels sprouts and trim rough ends. Shred by slicing thinly or using a mandoline slicer; transfer to salad bowl and toss with dressing.
Wash grapes and apples. Halve and add grapes to salad bowl. Core, medium dice, and add apples to salad bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts; add to salad bowl. Grate ½ cup of Parmesan; add to salad bowl.
Serve salad on a plate and enjoy!
author: Mealime
